flexible_post_content.text_editor:
It’s back! Agency Field Day – an afternoon of fun and healthy competition for Philadelphia’s digital agencies – will return to Fairmount Park for its third year this summer.

Last year, teams from O3 World, Bluecadet, Inverse Paradox, Seer Interactive, and Tonic Design Co. faced off in events, including an obstacle relay, dodgeball, and flip cup. This year, we’re looking to take it up a notch! To learn more about Agency Field Day, check out the #PHLAgencyFieldDay hashtag on Instagram and Twitter. If you want to get your agency involved, contact us using the button below!
